basis: Developer: Vayun Mathur (GPL-3.0, part of the 'Modern Apps' monorepo). No Google Play listing could be found (play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vayunmathur.camera returns 404; searches surface only IzzyOnDroid and F-Droid), so the app was identified through those stores and the local settings dump, whose labels ('Video codec', 'AV1 — Most efficient', 'Location', 'Save location in photo metadata') match this app's strings.xml exactly. The features come from the listing text (metadata_data/camera.md) and the app's source at commit 81d4eec (2026-10-19): UI composables, the strings.xml labels and the manifest. Labels are the app's own English strings. The local dump shows an older or device-limited settings screen with only two sections, because the codec section appears only when more than one encoder exists. Note: this is a general-purpose camera with a few manual controls (exposure time, ISO, EV), not a dedicated pro app: it has no manual focus, manual white balance, RAW, histogram or focus peaking (searched the source and found none). Source URLs below point at the default branch; the inventory was read at 81d4eec.

features.name: Photo
features.what: Default still mode with auto exposure; also used for Motion Photo and the manual exposure-time and ISO bars

features.name: Portrait
features.what: Background-blur stills using on-device segmentation (MediaPipe selfie and MODNet matting)
features.match_note: Vendor True Portrait only: Camera1-only Qualcomm vendor setting; not shown under Camera2; no segmentation blur

features.name: Pano
features.what: Horizontal panorama: guide dots lead the sweep, and a native Rust engine stitches the result
features.match_note: No panorama capture or stitching

features.name: Sphere
features.what: Full 360° photo sphere (equirectangular) captured on a guide-dot grid, with panorama XMP metadata written
features.match_note: No 360 photo sphere

features.name: Video
features.what: Normal video recording with audio at the highest fps and quality available (no resolution or fps picker)

features.name: Slo-Mo
features.what: High-frame-rate (HFR) slow-motion video; back camera only; the mode shows only when the device supports true HFR
features.match_note: Only through a high-speed video profile where the phone lists one; no dedicated slow-motion mode or slowed playback

features.name: Cinematic
features.what: Video with the device's preferred video stabilization turned on, with audio
features.match_note: Stabilisation toggle in normal video mode

features.name: Timelapse
features.what: Records normally, then remuxes the clip at a fixed 8x speed-up (no interval choice); no audio
features.match_note: Interval stills (and a timelapse profile/frame rate), not a sped-up video clip in one step

features.name: Night (auto night)
features.what: In a dark scene a Night pill appears and the vendor NIGHT extension or a native burst-alignment night capture is used; tap the pill to turn night off for that scene
features.match_note: No automatic night mode; frames can be shot as DNG and stacked afterwards by hand

features.name: Night strength readout (Night N%)
features.what: Shows the live strength of the vendor night processing while night is active
features.match_note: No night processing to report on

features.name: Motion Photo
features.what: Plain 4:3 Photo captures automatically save a Motion Photo (a short clip of the moments before the shot is embedded in the JPEG)
features.match_note: No Motion Photo (pre-shot clip embedded in JPEG)

features.name: Ultra HDR JPEG
features.what: Photos keep the Ultra HDR gain map where the device produces one
features.match_note: No Ultra HDR gain-map JPEG

features.name: Flash (On / Off / Auto)
features.what: Cycles the flash mode for stills; hidden on lenses with no flash unit

features.name: Torch
features.what: Keeps the LED on continuously in video modes
features.match_note: Torch is one of the flash modes

features.name: Grid
features.what: Turns a composition grid overlay on or off

features.name: Level
features.what: Horizon indicator that rotates with device roll and turns green within ±1.5°; photo modes

features.name: Aspect Ratio
features.what: Cycles the still crop through 16:9, 4:3, 3:2 and 1:1 (Photo and Portrait only)
features.match_note: Aspect follows the chosen picture size; no crop cycling on the camera screen

features.name: Timer
features.what: Cycles the self-timer through off, 3 s, 5 s and 10 s, with an on-screen countdown

features.name: Mic mute
features.what: Mutes or unmutes audio for video recordings (video modes)
features.match_note: Audio can be switched off per custom video profile in the editor; no quick mute on the camera screen

features.name: Brightness
features.what: Exposure-compensation slider, applied in Photo and Portrait

features.name: Shadows
features.what: Slider that lifts or deepens shadows, baked into saved stills (Photo and Portrait)
features.match_note: Shadows are shaped through a full tone curve (Camera2), not a one-slider lift

features.name: Warmth
features.what: Colour-temperature (warm/cool) slider, baked into saved stills (Photo and Portrait)
features.match_note: Kelvin white balance does the warm/cool job

features.name: Exposure time
features.what: Manual shutter-speed bar with stops (Auto plus fixed times), Photo mode only

features.name: ISO
features.what: Manual ISO bar (Auto or a sensitivity stop; shows N/A when unsupported), Photo mode only

features.name: Blur
features.what: Portrait background-blur strength slider
features.match_note: No adjustable background blur

features.name: Camera lens (UW / 1x / Tele / Mono / Front)
features.what: Picks a physical lens, each pill showing its focal length; hidden when only one lens exists
features.match_note: Cycles camera ids without focal-length pills; a physical lens behind a logical camera needs the Physical Camera setting

features.name: Zoom bar
features.what: Preset zoom levels with the live ratio inserted between them

features.name: Pinch to zoom
features.what: Zooms the viewfinder with a two-finger pinch
features.match_note: Zoom by strip only; no pinch gesture on the preview

features.name: Tap to focus
features.what: Focuses and meters on the tapped point
features.match_note: Tap on preview focuses (and meters with AE Meter Area) in auto-focus modes; no census entry of its own

features.name: AE/AF LOCK
features.what: Long-press on the preview locks focus and exposure on that point, with an indicator pill
features.match_note: Exposure lock button only; no long-press joint AE/AF lock on a point

features.name: Shutter / Burst
features.what: Tap to capture; hold for a burst with a 'Burst N' counter
features.match_note: Shutter is the same; burst is a preset count on the strip, not hold-to-burst

features.name: Pause / resume recording
features.what: Pauses and resumes a video or cinematic recording (replaces the gallery thumbnail while recording)
features.match_note: No pause/resume while recording

features.name: Video snapshot
features.what: Takes a still while recording, where the device supports it
features.match_note: No still capture during recording

features.name: Flip camera
features.what: Switches between the front and back cameras (not in Slo-Mo)

features.name: Volume-key shutter
features.what: Hardware volume keys fire the shutter while the camera screen is in front (Esc/space on desktop keyboards)
features.match_note: Camera and headset keys fire the shutter; volume keys step the active manual value instead; no census entry

features.name: QR Code scanning
features.what: Detects QR/barcodes in the viewfinder and offers Open URL / Copy / Cancel; shows 'QR scanning paused' when the night session blocks it
features.match_note: Not a photography job; no QR scanning

features.name: Add eSIM
features.what: When a scanned QR is an eSIM activation code, hands it to the system eSIM installer
features.match_note: Not a photography job

features.name: Passkey QR
features.what: FIDO passkey (hybrid sign-in) QR codes open in the system handler
features.match_note: Not a photography job

features.name: Panorama guide / Processing panorama…
features.what: On-screen guide dots for Pano/Sphere sweeps, then a stitching progress screen
features.match_note: No panorama guide or stitching

features.name: Gallery
features.what: Thumbnail of the last capture opens it in the system gallery, or the gallery collection if it is gone
features.match_note: Gallery button opens GlassCam's own viewer

features.name: Settings (gear)
features.what: Opens the settings page from the bottom controls

features.name: Video codec
features.what: Picks H.264/AVC (Most compatible), H.265/HEVC (More efficient) or AV1 (Most efficient); shown only when more than one encoder exists
features.match_note: Codec is chosen inside a custom video profile in the editor, not a single settings row

features.name: Audio input source
features.what: Mic source for video: Camcorder (default), Microphone, Voice (noise/echo cancel) or Unprocessed (raw)
features.match_note: Unprocessed source is commented out

features.name: Selfie mirroring
features.what: Mirrors the front-camera preview and saved selfies
features.match_note: No selfie mirroring option

features.name: Noise reduction
features.what: Toggles noise reduction in photos and video (off keeps raw detail)

features.name: Edge sharpening
features.what: Toggles edge sharpening in photos and video (off gives a natural look)
features.match_note: Camera2 edge mode

features.name: Motion photo length
features.what: Chooses how many seconds of pre-shot video a Motion Photo keeps
features.match_note: No Motion Photo

features.name: Location
features.what: 'Save location in photo metadata': writes GPS into EXIF

features.name: Save location
features.what: Default DCIM/Camera, Choose folder (system folder picker) or Reset to default

features.name: System camera / capture for other apps
features.what: Handles other apps' 'take a photo' / 'record video' requests and the still-camera intents
features.match_note: Answers image-capture requests only; no video-capture intent

features.name: Lockscreen camera
features.what: Opens over the lock screen (secure still-camera intent, show-when-locked)

features.name: Wide-window layout
features.what: On tablets and foldables the shutter and mode controls sit side by side below the preview
features.match_note: No tablet/foldable side-by-side layout

features.name: 100% offline
features.what: No internet permission; all processing is on the device
features.match_note: Processing is on-device, but the app holds INTERNET permission (flat-field data download)
